# Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the recent log entries of a running active agent session.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog [-Name] <string> [-Tail <int>] [-Level <LogLevel>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog cmdlet writes the log entries the active agent session named in -Name keeps in its own bounded buffer: what it asked the server, what it sent and what went wrong, with a timestamp, a level and a category. The session runs in the background, so its log is the place to see why values do not arrive. -Tail keeps the last entries and -Level the entries at or above a level; Clear-ZbxActiveAgentLog empties the buffer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read the last log entries of an agent

```powershell
Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog -Name 'web-agent' -Tail 10 | Select-Object Timestamp, Level, Message
```

Each entry has a Timestamp, a Level, a Category and the Message.

### Example 2: Show only warnings and errors

```powershell
Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog -Name 'web-agent' -Level Warning
```

-Level keeps the entries at or above the level given.
